ITEM.PTXT: When the window lock switch is turned ON with the IG ON or during key-off operation, a window lock switch ON signal is sent from the master switch to the main body ECU and each seat power window motor (with built-in ECU) via LIN communication.
While each seat power window motor (with built-in ECU) is receiving the "window lock" signal, power window control of its own door glass is stopped.
